item.title: Cakes & Bakes 1.0
item.creator: Some Game Studio
item.description:
Live the complete bakery dream with our Cakes & Bakes Add-On! Expand your farm & homestead with awesome NEW cooking stations, rustling up sweet treats. Mix, Churn, Blend, Fry AND Bake ingredients into your favorite culinary delights.

+ Sneaky Raccoon!
+ 100+ 3D Dishes & Produce
+ 300+ Ingredients & Food Items
+ Bakery & Café Themed Blocks
+ Interactive Cooking System

howToEntries.heading: 1. First Steps
howToEntries.content:
- Using a regular Crafting Table, craft a Baker's Workbench and Baker's Recipes.
- Place the Baker's Recipes on top of the Baker’s Workbench to activate the Cakes & Bakes Workbench.
- Use it to craft a Baker's Market Stall. Placing the stall spawns a Village Baker.

howToEntries.heading: 2. Seeds and Ingredients
howToEntries.content:
- Trade with the Village Baker for new crop seeds and saplings that grow the ingredients needed for baking.
- The Village Baker offers seeds at Level 1 and fruit tree saplings at Level 2.

howToEntries.heading: 3. Building the Bakery
howToEntries.content:
- Craft the Baker's Prep Table and Baker's Stove, then add the respective topper blocks to create stations such as the Mixing Bowl, Blender, Copper Cauldron, Tea Pot, and Pan.
- The Millstone, Fruit Press, Ice Churn, and Butter Churn do not need a base block.

howToEntries.heading: 4. Multi-block Workstations
howToEntries.content: - Build the Baking Oven by placing 8 Oven Brick in a 2x2x2 cube.

howToEntries.heading: 5. Interactive Baking
howToEntries.content:
- Most appliances are Interactive Stations. To craft you have to add the ingredients directly to the station. Once the correct recipe is assembled, crafting starts.
- Hold the Guidebook while interacting with a station to view its recipes.
- Some recipes require an extra item like a bottle to collect the finished product.
